title: Bhaiyya, Emergency Fund Ka Jugaad!
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, one cute glossy non-human cartoon mascot character with big expressive eyes, arms and legs and a small headband, centered, simple clean colourful background, sharp focus, hyper-detailed, soft cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16
img_suffix: The character is NOT a person: no human face, no girl, no boy, no extra people. No text, no watermark, no logos.

sikka_seth.look: A small, shiny, golden coin with big, wise eyes, a small red cape, and a blue headband. Always looks ready to help and confident.

kharche_kaka.look: A slightly crumpled, purple-colored bill (like a receipt) with a mischievous grin, one eye winking, a small red tie, and a green headband. Looks a bit sneaky but harmless.

scenes.image: [[sikka_seth]] with a determined look, flexing his tiny coin muscles.
scenes.speaker: sikka_seth
scenes.line: Arre bhai! Tera emergency fund kahan hai? Tension nahi lene ka!
scenes.say: अरे भाई! तेरा इमरजेंसी फंड कहाँ है? टेंशन नहीं लेने का!

scenes.image: [[sikka_seth]] with a determined look, flexing his tiny coin muscles.
scenes.speaker: sikka_seth
scenes.line: Main Sikka Seth! Tera mushkil ghadi ka asli dost, bole toh!
scenes.say: मैं सिक्का सेठ! तेरा मुश्किल घड़ी का असली दोस्त, बोले तो!

scenes.image: [[sikka_seth]] with a determined look, flexing his tiny coin muscles.
scenes.speaker: sikka_seth
scenes.line: Emergency fund? Jab life mein lafda ho, yeh kaam aata hai, bhidu!
scenes.say: इमरजेंसी फंड? जब लाइफ में लफड़ा हो, ये काम आता है, भिडू!

scenes.image: [[kharche_kaka]] looking innocent but with a sly smile, shrugging.
scenes.speaker: kharche_kaka
scenes.line: Ae Sikka Seth, main hoon Kharche Kaka! Kabhi bhi tapak jata hoon!
scenes.say: ऐ सिक्का सेठ, मैं हूँ खर्चे काका! कभी भी टपक जाता हूँ!

scenes.image: [[kharche_kaka]] looking innocent but with a sly smile, shrugging.
scenes.speaker: kharche_kaka
scenes.line: Sudden expenses toh aate hi rehte hain, ekdum pakka!
scenes.say: सडन एक्सपेंसेस तो आते ही रहते हैं, एकदम पक्का!

scenes.image: [[kharche_kaka]] looking innocent but with a sly smile, shrugging.
scenes.speaker: kharche_kaka
scenes.line: Agar ready nahi, toh budget ka band baja deta hoon, sun!
scenes.say: अगर रेडी नहीं, तो बजट का बैंड बजा देता हूँ, सुन!

scenes.image: [[sikka_seth]] looking serious and wise, pointing to his chest.
scenes.speaker: sikka_seth
scenes.line: Yeh woh paisa hai jo safe jagah pe rakha hota hai, ekdum easy!
scenes.say: ये वो पैसा है जो सेफ जगह पे रखा होता है, एकदम ईज़ी!

scenes.image: [[sikka_seth]] looking serious and wise, pointing to his chest.
scenes.speaker: sikka_seth
scenes.line: Bole toh, jab koi achanak bimari ya job ka lafda ho.
scenes.say: बोले तो, जब कोई अचानक बीमारी या जॉब का लफड़ा हो।

scenes.image: [[sikka_seth]] looking serious and wise, pointing to his chest.
scenes.speaker: sikka_seth
scenes.line: Tera monthly kharcha cover karne ke liye hota hai, tension gone!
scenes.say: तेरा मंथली खर्चा कवर करने के लिए होता है, टेंशन गॉन!

scenes.image: [[kharche_kaka]] looking triumphant, waving a small flag with a rupee sign.
scenes.speaker: kharche_kaka
scenes.line: Gaadi kharab, fridge off, ya phir doctor ka bill?
scenes.say: गाड़ी खराब, फ्रिज ऑफ, या फिर डॉक्टर का बिल?

scenes.image: [[kharche_kaka]] looking triumphant, waving a small flag with a rupee sign.
scenes.speaker: kharche_kaka
scenes.line: Main aake tera jeb khaali kar sakta hoon, haan haan!
scenes.say: मैं आके तेरा जेब खाली कर सकता हूँ, हाँ हाँ!

scenes.image: [[kharche_kaka]] looking triumphant, waving a small flag with a rupee sign.
scenes.speaker: kharche_kaka
scenes.line: Lekin Sikka Seth hai toh tu mujhe bol sakta hai 'Chal hat!'
scenes.say: लेकिन सिक्का सेठ है तो तू मुझे बोल सकता है 'चल हट!'

scenes.image: [[sikka_seth]] with a big smile, holding a small piggy bank.
scenes.speaker: sikka_seth
scenes.line: Kitna? Kam se kam 3 se 6 mahine ka kharcha, ekdum minimum!
scenes.say: कितना? कम से कम 3 से 6 महीने का खर्चा, एकदम मिनिमम!

scenes.image: [[sikka_seth]] with a big smile, holding a small piggy bank.
scenes.speaker: sikka_seth
scenes.line: Aise account mein rakh jahan se fatfat nikal sake, haan!
scenes.say: ऐसे अकाउंट में रख जहाँ से फटाफट निकाल सके, हाँ!

scenes.image: [[sikka_seth]] with a big smile, holding a small piggy bank.
scenes.speaker: sikka_seth
scenes.line: Zaroorat se zyada ya risky jagah mat rakh, bhidu!
scenes.say: ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा या रिस्की जगह मत रख, भिडू!

scenes.image: [[sikka_seth]] giving a thumbs up, looking confident and helpful.
scenes.speaker: sikka_seth
scenes.line: Investments are subject to market risks, yaad rakhna!
scenes.say: इन्वेस्टमेंट्स आर सब्जेक्ट टू मार्केट रिस्क, याद रखना!

scenes.image: [[sikka_seth]] giving a thumbs up, looking confident and helpful.
scenes.speaker: sikka_seth
scenes.line: Kisi bade plan ke liye, SEBI-registered adviser se pooch.
scenes.say: किसी बड़े प्लान के लिए, सेबी-रजिस्टर्ड एडवाइज़र से पूछ।

scenes.image: [[sikka_seth]] giving a thumbs up, looking confident and helpful.
scenes.speaker: sikka_seth
scenes.line: Tera emergency fund ready hai kya? Comment mein batao!
scenes.say: तेरा इमरजेंसी फंड रेडी है क्या? कमेंट में बताओ!
